newsitem.title: POLAND: FORECAST-Polish 3-mo WIBOR seen at 18.51% end-97.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST-Polish 3-mo WIBOR seen at 18.51% end-97.

text.p: The Warsaw Interbank Offered Rate (WIBOR) for three-month deposits is expected to drop to 18.51 percent by yearend from 22.45 percent on Friday, a Reuter poll of Poland's 25 biggest banks showed.
The prediction is a mean average of banks' forecasts ranging between 16.50 percent and 20.80 percent. Last month, banks saw the rate at 17.43 percent on average at the end of 1997.

Banks expected the rate to ease to 18.29 percent in January 1998, with predictions ranging from 16.6 to 20.75 percent. This month, they see an average rate of 22.25 percent from a range of 16.5 to 23.2 percent. -- Warsaw Newsroom +48 22 653 9700
